subject: general
question: How many awards were presented at the National Sports and Adventure Awards-2022 ceremony held at Rashtrapati Bhavan on 30 November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**44**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Sports and Adventure Awards-2022** ceremony held on **30 November 2022** at **Rashtrapati Bhavan** recognized the achievements of outstanding individuals in the fields of sports and adventure. 
 
• A total of **44 awards** were presented across various categories.
 
• The awards were presented by **President Droupadi Murmu** at the Rashtrapati Bhavan.
 
• The event celebrated a wide range of sports and adventure activities, highlighting India's growing stature in both areas on the global stage.
 
• Athletes from different disciplines, including cricket, boxing, wrestling, and athletics, were honored.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Types of Awards in Event
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**:
 
 
• India’s highest sporting honor, awarded for the most outstanding performance in sports over the past four years.
 
• **1 recipient** in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Arjuna Award**:
 
 
• Given to athletes for consistently excellent performances over the past four years.
 
• **25 recipients** in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Dronacharya Award** (Lifetime and Regular categories):
 
 
• Presented to coaches for producing exceptional sportspersons.
 
• **7 recipients** in total (both lifetime and regular categories).
 
 
 
• **Dhyan Chand Award** for Lifetime Achievement:
 
 
• Honors sportspersons for their lifetime contribution to sports.
 
• **4 recipients** in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar**:
 
 
• Recognizes corporate entities, sports promotion boards, or individuals who have contributed to the promotion and development of sports.
 
• **2 recipients** in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy**:
 
 
• Awarded to the best performing university in sports.
 
• **1 recipient** in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award**:
 
 
• Given for excellence in adventure activities on land, water, and air, as well as lifetime achievements in adventure sports.
 
• **4 recipients** in 2022.
